It was a cold winter evening. It was dark. It was too cold to waste any more time outside so I was hurrying to get home. I'd raised the collar of my jacket and my knit cap was down past my eyebrows. As I was walking down the empty street, I noticed the girl walking a few meters in front of me. She was hurrying too. Right then, a thought crossed my mind:

"Man, I sure do look like some kind of creepy-ass rapist guy."

Maybe the girl in front of me was actually scared and that was why she was walking so fast.

"I should just start walking faster and leave the poor girl behind, so she knows that I'm not a threat", I think.

So I just charge toward her with the intention of passing. When I get next to her, she stops and screams. I do my best to ignore her reaction and keep on walking home, as if nothing happened. I bet we both felt like assholes.
